import numpy as np, cv2, json, time
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline, PchipInterpolator
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
D=Path('/app/output')
# Root path in image pixels, with brush width in pixels.
initial=[
[[455,220,1],[478,232,26],[510,252,49],[538,277,39],[529,291,0]],
[[372,383,1],[413,383,16],[474,365,23],[507,378,40],[507,425,36],[507,530,36],[507,653,40],[510,731,46],[491,771,47],[464,750,24],[404,714,0]],
[[244,508,0],[281,517,22],[351,501,26],[411,489,28],[420,505,39],[390,566,42],[347,632,35],[301,682,22],[253,720,0]],
[[653,355,0],[680,380,45],[674,400,38],[624,435,28],[574,471,16],[538,499,0]],
[[515,479,0],[549,526,21],[598,581,33],[650,626,47],[701,662,63],[750,671,31],[806,673,0]]]

def sample(a,step=2):
 a=np.array(a); t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(a[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]; t=t/t[-1]
 tt=np.linspace(0,1,max(50,int(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(a[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))/step)))
 xy=CubicSpline(t,a[:,:2],bc_type='natural')(tt); der=CubicSpline(t,a[:,:2],bc_type='natural')(tt,1)
 w=PchipInterpolator(t,a[:,2])(tt).clip(.01)
 th=np.arctan2(der[:,1],der[:,0]);return np.c_[xy,w,th]

def render(a,res=512):
 out=np.zeros((res,res),np.uint8); sc=res/1024
 for x,y,w,th in sample(a):
  d=(1.38+1.075*(w*.22185987+.3)/1.187)/.22185987
  # front straight edge, parabolic trailing edge
  v=np.linspace(-.5,.5,13); back=np.c_[-d*(1-4*v*v),w*v]
  cs,sn=np.cos(th),np.sin(th); rot=np.array([[cs,sn],[-sn,cs]])
  pts=(back@rot+[x,y])*sc
  cv2.fillPoly(out,[np.round(pts*256).astype(np.int32)],255,lineType=cv2.LINE_AA,shift=8)
 return out.astype(float)/255

res=512
T=cv2.resize(np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0],(res,res),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)<100
outside=cv2.distanceTransform((~T).astype(np.uint8),cv2.DIST_L2,5)/(res/1024)
inside=cv2.distanceTransform(T.astype(np.uint8),cv2.DIST_L2,5)/(res/1024)
weight_out=1.6+np.minimum(outside/6,4)
weight_in=1+np.minimum(inside/8,1)

def loss(ink):
 return (np.sum(ink[~T]*weight_out[~T])+np.sum((1-ink[T])*weight_in[T]))/T.sum()

def report(paths,name):
 masks=[render(a) for a in paths]; ink=np.maximum.reduce(masks); B=ink>.5
 print(name, 'loss',loss(ink),'iou',np.sum(B&T)/np.sum(B|T),'recall',np.sum(B&T)/T.sum(),'stray',np.sum(B&(outside>4.507))/T.sum(),flush=True)
 rgb=np.full((res,res,3),248,np.uint8);rgb[T]=[150,150,150];rgb[B&~T]=[220,70,60];rgb[B&T]=[25,25,25]
 Image.fromarray(rgb).save(D/(name+'.png'))
 json.dump([np.asarray(p).tolist() for p in paths],open(D/(name+'.json'),'w'))

if __name__=='__main__':
 import sys
 paths=[np.array(x,float) for x in (json.load(open(sys.argv[1])) if len(sys.argv)>1 else initial)]
 report(paths,'initial')
 for cycle in range(3):
  for j in range(5):
   a=paths[j].copy(); others=np.maximum.reduce([render(p) for k,p in enumerate(paths) if k!=j])
   # optimize all coordinates and interior widths; zero width endpoints remain
   ix=np.ones(a.shape,bool);ix[0,2]=ix[-1,2]=False
   x0=a[ix];bounds=[]
   for row,col in zip(*np.where(ix)):
    bounds.append((max(.1,a[row,col]-25),min(78,a[row,col]+25)) if col==2 else (a[row,col]-25,a[row,col]+25))
   def fun(x):
    b=a.copy(); b[ix]=x
    return loss(np.maximum(others,render(b)))
   st=time.time();opt=minimize(fun,x0,method='Powell',bounds=bounds,options={'maxiter':12,'xtol':.15,'ftol':.00008})
   a[ix]=opt.x; paths[j]=a
   print(cycle,j,opt.fun,opt.nfev,'sec',time.time()-st,flush=True)
   report(paths,'fit')
  report(paths,'cycle'+str(cycle))

"""Copy 永 with five pressure-varying lengthwise brush strokes.
The control points describe the contact root; the tool path compensates
for the brush's pressure-dependent bend and the robot's tracking delay.
"""
import numpy as np, json, time, pickle, argparse
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline, PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from fit import sample
D=Path('/app/output'); PX=.22185986964255727

def tip_path(nodes,speed=6.,dt=.05):
 root=sample(nodes,step=.3)
 xy=root[:,:2]*PX
 width=root[:,2]*PX
 z=(width+.3)/1.187
 offset=np.maximum(0,(-.967*(z/10)**2+2.109994*z/10-.036001727)*10)
 # Discrete inverse of the brush's anchored-root law.
 deriv=np.vstack([xy[1]-xy[0],np.diff(xy,axis=0)])
 tangent=deriv/np.linalg.norm(deriv,axis=1)[:,None]
 tipxy=xy+offset[:,None]*tangent
 path=np.c_[tipxy,z]
 # Start and finish with a vertical approach/release at negligible width.
 path=np.vstack([np.r_[tipxy[0],-2.],path,np.r_[tipxy[-1],-2.]])
 dist=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1))]
 tt=np.linspace(0,dist[-1],int(np.ceil(dist[-1]/(speed*dt)))+1)
 out=np.column_stack([np.interp(tt,dist,path[:,i]) for i in range(3)])
 return out

def main():
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--paths',default=str(D/'fit.json'));parser.add_argument('--name',default='trial');parser.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=6);parser.add_argument('--lag',type=float,default=.10);parser.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');a=parser.parse_args()
 paths=json.load(open(a.paths));s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.reset();s.record_start()
 for i,nodes in enumerate(paths):
  # Restore the gathered hairs before each stroke.
  p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.060],speed=.08,settle=3)
  p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.022],speed=.035,settle=4)
  p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.060],speed=.05,settle=3)
  path=tip_path(nodes,speed=a.speed)
  wx,wy=s.geo.mm_to_world(path[:,0],path[:,1]);world=np.c_[wx,wy,.020-path[:,2]/1000]
  p['move_tip']([world[0,0],world[0,1],.05],speed=.08,settle=4)
  p['move_tip'](world[0],speed=.025,settle=6)
  # First-order feedforward for the PD tracking delay.
  vel=np.gradient(world,.05,axis=0)
  targets=world+a.lag*vel
  errs=[]
  for v in targets:
   q,ok,e=s.ik(v)
   if not ok: raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,v,e))
   s.step(q)
   errs.append(s.tip_pose()[0])
  p['move_tip']([world[-1,0],world[-1,1],.055],speed=.03,settle=6)
  print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
  np.savez(D/(a.name+'_track'+str(i)+'.npz'),desired=world,actual=np.array(errs))
 acts=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(acts,D/(a.name+'.npz'))
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(D/(a.name+'.png'))
 np.save(D/(a.name+'_ink.npy'),s.ink())
 pickle.dump(s.strokes(),open(D/(a.name+'_strokes.pkl'),'wb'))
 print('saved',len(acts),'state',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 if a.score:
  score=s.score();json.dump(score,open(D/(a.name+'_score.json'),'w'),indent=2);print(score,flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
